name: Camp Matoaka
description_short: Overnight camp for girls on East Pond in Smithfield, Maine, open since 1951. Girls choose from over 30 activities, including tennis, gymnastics, swimming, dance, theater, arts and riding, in two 3.5-week half sessions or one 7-week full session.
refund_policy_summary: A fully refundable $3,000 deposit is due with the online application. The page doesn't give a refund policy for the rest of the tuition. Card payments after the deposit carry a 3% fee.
special_needs_notes: A Food Allergy Coach and five nurses support campers with food allergies, dietary restrictions and medical needs. The site doesn't describe support for other special needs.
swim_waterfront_notes: Two swim areas: a 10,000 square-foot area on East Pond with three enclosed cribs and an aqua park, and a heated 25-meter pool with waterslides. Swim staff are lifeguards and certified instructors teaching the Red Cross curriculum; younger campers take three swim lessons a week.

sources.note: FAQ: 'Camp Matoaka is an accredited member of the American Camp Association.'

source.title: Camp Matoaka's Summer Camp Dates & Rates | Girls Summer Camp in ME

warnings: Extra costs on top of tuition: a $250 personal expense fee for half-session campers and $450 for full-session campers, a 3% fee on credit card payments made after the deposit, and nominal transportation fees.
The page footer says © 2025, but the dates are clearly marked as the 2027 season. The weekdays match the 2027 calendar.
Visiting Day for the Full Session is Sunday, July 18, 2027.
